stem: What happens next in this passage after “Others go only a few streets away.”?
options: Many are simple messages: "Thank you for helping me," "I miss you," or "Good luck on your test."

But she knew the real luck had been practice, calmness, and a friend's good words.
Linda said she had folded the paper many times before finding a good shape.
